scope: Actual-app smoke only; no source or documentation edits
fixture: Two isolated real backends, each with identical 12-turn fake ACP transcripts (24 messages). Four-line drafts inserted with CDP Input.insertText, exact value and unchanged message count asserted.

result.afterTablet768x800: Bottom gap remains zero after composer growth and viewport shrink to height550; trusted-wheel reading offset6531 unchanged after resize to height650.
result.beforePhone390x700: Shrink to height450 during composer morph leaves bottom gap298px.
result.afterPhone390x700: Same shrink leaves bottom gap0px. Trusted-wheel reading offset10561 remains unchanged after resize to height550, with gap561px; not forced to bottom.

exclude: Other non-clean captures and older trace files are exploratory diagnostics, not final acceptance evidence.
limits: Chromium emulation only; focused viewport shrink models keyboard geometry, not an actual mobile keyboard. No physical-device verification. Fake agent can split UTF-8 mid-codepoint, producing occasional replacement glyphs in echoed dummy text.
